Elevate Your Office Experience

Discover a workspace designed to inspire success and support growth. At iQ Offices, we provide an environment where teams thrive, offering ultimate flexibility and premium services.

Get in Touch

Exceptional Service for Your Operations

We understand that your primary focus is your business, including creating an exceptional experience for your employees. Our comprehensive service offering ensures that everything, from IT support to office maintenance, runs seamlessly. This allows you to concentrate on what truly matters: your success.

Thoughtful Design for Maximum Productivity

iQ Offices workspaces are built to boost both focus and creativity. With ergonomic furniture, plenty of natural light, and modern design touches throughout, we’ve created an environment that helps you do your best work—whether you're leading a team, building a business, or launching your next big idea.

Unmatched Privacy for Your Peace of Mind

Privacy and security come standard. With dedicated offices and advanced security systems, your confidential information stays protected. Work without distractions in a space designed to support focus, protect your data, and give you the peace of mind needed to achieve your business goals.

Service

Customized Solutions for Every Business

Whether you’re a solo entrepreneur, a growing team, or an established enterprise, iQ Offices offers tailored workspace solutions to fuel your success, from Private Offices to on-demand Meeting Rooms.

Leading the Way in Canada for Coworking

A Canadian-owned and operated coworking provider since 2012, iQ Offices is proud to serve cities nationwide. Our premium workspaces in Toronto, Ottawa, Montreal and Vancouver are designed to support a variety of business needs. Explore our locations and see how we can help you succeed.

Trusted by Businesses Nationwide

Explore how iQ Offices fosters business growth and success nationwide. Over 500 Members rating us 5 stars for our exceptional service and premium workspaces that help clients achieve their goals with satisfaction.

“From the moment I stepped into the iQ Offices at 150 King West, I was immediately impressed by the space, the amenities, and most importantly, the iQ Offices team. From day one, they have been incredibly welcoming and helpful."

“It’s a nice coworking space in a great location in the city. The staff are super nice, helpful, always available, and open to hearing any feedback to address issues quickly. The Thursday happy hours are enjoyable, especially when the weather allows for time on the balcony.”

Brooke C.

"Working in iQ Offices is exceptional, there are extremely kind and helpful staff who help create a welcoming office community. The space is open and well-designed, with a great office view as well. Michelle H.

"I recently had the opportunity to book a meeting space at iQ Offices, and it exceeded my expectations. The staff was exceptionally helpful, assisting with the tech setup and ensuring everything functioned perfectly. As an added bonus, they provided complimentary snacks to keep us energized throughout the meeting."

Wendy H.

"I have nothing but amazing things to say. Such friendly helpful staff. Every time I need help with something, they are there to help me figure it out. Love the social atmosphere, and events that bring everyone out to chat. Happy hours are amazing and really help everyone get to know each other. Coffee and snacks are a great bonus too :)"

Juliana L.

"Our company has had an exceptional experience with iQ Offices. The team is incredibly supportive, the installations are beautifully comfortable, maintaining a clean and tidy environment. The ambiance is kind and welcoming–an ideal coworking space."
